player_prompt.intro:
Aslii ɗe Lights Out! A yahi kisal {size}x{size} e ɓe ɗeen. 
Goɗɗo a yaha ɗon ɓeyda ALL ɓe ɗeen (ɗon ɓeyda e '.') 
Waktu a tatta ɗeen, ɗon ɓeyda e ɓe ɗon haɓɓa (himo/aɓɓa/ɓiyal/ɗawal). 
Tatta [row col] ɗon tatta ɗeen (0-indexed, haaɓa ɓeyda ɗe 0-{max_index}). 
A yahi ɓe ɗon haɓɓa {max_turns} koƴɛɛ ɗon ɓeyda puzzle. 
Legend: 'O' = ɗeen ɗon ɓey, '.' = ɗeen ɗon ɓeyda
